desc: Ideate approaches and select the canonical-tree best-first heap as the primary solution.
Implement the canonical-tree 3D heap solution with packed heap keys and incremental value updates.
Validate on samples and edge cases: N=1, K=1, K=N^3 for small N, all equal values, large values, and K<N truncation.
Confirm complexity O(N log N + K log K) and memory are acceptable; no fallback needed.
